ऋ: ऋ The seventh vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, and peculiar to it. It corresponds in sound with RI, in merrily.

ऋ f. (आ) A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods. ind. 	 1. An expres-sion of abuse. 	 2. An articulate sound. 	 3. An expression of laugh-ter. 	 4. A sound inarticulate or reiterated as in stammering.

ऋ r. 1st cl. (ऋच्छति) 	 1. To go, to approach. 	 2. To gain, to acquire; (the radical is changed to ऋछ before an initial mute श.) r. 3rd cl. (ईयर्त्ति) To go; (some confine this root to the Vedas.) r. 5th cl. (ऋणोति) To kill, to injure; also रि.
ऋक्थ: ऋक्थ n. (-थं) 	 1. Wealth, possessions, property. 	 2. Gold.  E. ऋच् to praise, थक् Unādi aff.
ऋक्थग्रहण: ऋक्थग्रहण n. (-णं) Receiving or inheriting property.  E. ऋक्थ wealth and ग्रहण taking.
ऋक्थग्राह: ऋक्थग्राह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Who inherits or takes property. 	 m. (-हः) in-heriting or receiving property.  E. ऋक्थ and ग्रह् to take, with घञ् affix; also with णिनि, ऋक्थग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि.)
ऋक्थजात: ऋक्थजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Accumulated, added, (as property.)  E. ऋक्थ wealth and जात produced.
ऋक्थभाग: ऋक्थभाग m. (-गः) 	 1. Division of property, inheritance, partition. 	 2. A share.  E. ऋक्थ property and भाग division.
ऋक्थभागिन्: ऋक्थभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) An heir, a coheir, inheriting or sharing property.  E. ऋक्थ and भागिन् who shares.
ऋक्थहर: ऋक्थहर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) An heir, a coheir.  E. ऋक्थ and हर who takes.
ऋक्थहारिन्: ऋक्थहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) An heir, inheriting or sharing property. E. ऋक्थ and हारिन् who takes.
ऋक्शत: ऋक्शत n. (-तं) A hundred texts.  E. ऋच् a prayer, and शत a century.
ऋक्संहिता: ऋक्संहिता f. (-ता) The collection of the prayers and hymns of the Rik Veda.  E. ऋच् and संहिता compendium.
ऋक्ष: ऋक्ष r. 5th cl. (ऋक्ष्णोति) To kill, to hurt or seek to hurt.

ऋक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Pierced, cut, divided. 	 mn. (-क्षः-क्षं) A star, a con-stellation. 	 m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A mountain in the peninsula, the temporary residence of RAMA. 	 2. A bear. 	 3. A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)  E. ऋष् to go, Unādi affix स, the radical final then becomes क, and स be-comes ष; and क and ष form the compound letter क्ष.
ऋक्षगन्धा: ऋक्षगन्धा f. (-न्धा) 	 1. A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) 	 2. Another sort, (Convolvulus paniculatus.)  E. ऋक्ष a bear, and गन्ध smell, smelling like a bear.
ऋक्षगन्धिका: ऋक्षगन्धिका f. (-का) A kind of potherb, (Convolvulus paniculatus, the pale sort:) see the preceding. E. As before, कन् added.
ऋक्षर: ऋक्षर n. (-रं) A shewer, a stream. 	 m. (-रः) A family priest.  E. ऋष् to go, and सर Unādi affix: see the derivation of ऋक्ष.
ऋक्षविभावन: ऋक्षविभावन n. (-नं) Observing or seeing the stars.  E. ऋक्ष and विभावन noticing.
ऋक्षेश: ऋक्षेश m. (-शः) The moon.  E. ऋक्ष a star, ईश lord.
ऋक्षेष्टि: ऋक्षेष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) Offering worship to the planets and stars.  E. ऋक्ष and इष्टि worship.
ऋग्वेद: ऋग्वेद m. (-दः) The Rich or Rik Veda, the first of the four Vedas. E. ऋच् and वेद a Veda.
ऋग्वेदविद्: ऋग्वेदविद् m. (-वित् or -विद्) A Brahman familiar with the Rik Veda. E. ऋग्वेद and विद् who knows.
ऋच्: ऋच् r. 6th cl. (ऋचति) 	 1. To praise. 	 2. To cover, to screen.

ऋच् f. (ऋक्) 	 1. Rik or Rig Veda, one of the four principal religious books of the Hindus. 	 2. A stanza of a prayer or hymn of the Rig Veda. 	 3. A mantra, a magical invocation, a mystical prayer. E. ऋच् to praise, affix क्विप्, celebrating the praises of the gods.
ऋचीष: ऋचीष n. (-षं) A frying pan. 	 m. (-षः) A hell.  E. ऋज् to fry, ईषन् affix, च substituted for ज; also ऋजीष.
ऋच्छ: ऋच्छ r. 6th cl. (ऋच्छति) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To fail in faculties. 	 3. To become hard or stiff, to congeal. 	 4. To incur.
ऋच्छरा: ऋच्छरा f. (-रा) A harlot, a courtezan.  E. ऋच्छ् to go, अर Unādi affix, and टाप् for the fem.
ऋज: ऋज r. 1st cl. (अर्जते) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To stand or be firm. 	 3. To be strong. 4. To acquire, to gain or earn. 	 5. To live. With a prefix ending in अ, the radical vowel is changed to आर, as in the pass. voice, (प्रार्ज्यते) (इ) ऋनि (ऋजते) To fry.
ऋजीक: ऋजीक m. (-कः) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. Smoke.  E. ऋज and कीकन् Uṇadi aff.
ऋजीष: ऋजीष n. (-षं) 	 1. A frying pan. 	 2. A hell.  E. ऋज् to fry, ईषन् Unādi affix: see ऋचीष.
ऋजु: ऋजु mfn. (-जुः-जुः-जु) 	 1. Straight. 	 2. Straight metaphorically, as in morals, upright, honest.  E. ऋज् to go, affix कु.
ऋजुकाय: ऋजुकाय m. (-यः) A name of the saint KASYAPA.  E. ऋजु straight, काय body.
ऋजुता: ऋजुता f. (-ता) 	 1. Uprightness, sincerity. 	 2. Straightness.  E. ऋजु with तल् affix; also with त्व, ऋजुत्वं.
ऋजूकरण: ऋजूकरण n. (-णं) Straightening.  E. ऋजु and करण making; the vowel lengthened.
ऋजूकृत: ऋजूकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made straight.  E. ऋजु and कृत made; the vowel lengthened.
ऋज्र: ऋज्र m. (-ज्रः) A leader.  E. ऋज् to go, रन् Unādi aff.
ऋञ्जसान: ऋञ्जसान m. (-नः) A cloud.  E. ऋजि to go, शानच् Unādi aff.
ऋण: ऋण r. 8th cl. (उ) ऋणु (अर्णोति or अर्णुते, ऋणोति or -णुते) To go; according to some it is ऋन.
ऋण n. (-णं) 	 1. Debt. 	 2. A fort, a strong hold. 	 3. (In algebra,) Ne-gative quantity, minus.  E. ऋ to go, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
ऋणकर्तृ: ऋणकर्तृ mfn. (-र्ता-त्री-र्तृ) Getting into debt, indebted.  E. ऋण and कर्तृ who makes.
ऋणग्रस्त: ऋणग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Indebted, involved in debt.  E. ऋण and ग्रस्त seized.
ऋणग्रह: ऋणग्रह m. (-हः) 	 1. Borrowing. 	 2. A borrower.  E. ऋण and ग्रह taking.
ऋणग्राहिन्: ऋणग्राहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि) Borrowing, a borrower.  E. ऋण and ग्राहिन् who takes.
ऋणदातृ: ऋणदातृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) One who pays a debt.  E. ऋण and दातृ who gives. Also ऋणद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) and ऋणदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि.)
ऋणदान: ऋणदान n. (-नं) Payment of debt.  E. ऋण and दान giving.
ऋणमत्कुण: ऋणमत्कुण m. (-णः) A security, a bail.  E. ऋण debt, मत्कुण an insect.
ऋणमार्गण: ऋणमार्गण m. (-णः) A security.  E. ऋण, मृग् to cleanse, in the causal, and ल्युट् affix.
ऋणमुक्ति: ऋणमुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Discharge of a debt.  E. ऋण and मुक्ति emancipation.
ऋणमोक्ष: ऋणमोक्ष m. (-क्षः) Paying a debt.  E. ऋण and मोक्ष released.
ऋणवत्: ऋणवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Owing, in debt.  E. ऋण and मतुप् aff.
ऋणशोधन: ऋणशोधन n. (-नं) Payment or discharge of a debt.  E. ऋण and शोधन purifying.
ऋणादान: ऋणादान n. (-नं) Recovery of a debt, receipt of money, &c. lent. It is one of the eighteen titles or subjects of judicial procedure.  E. ऋण and आदान receiving.
ऋणान्तक: ऋणान्तक m. (-कः) The planet MARS.  E. ऋण, अन्त end, and क affix of agency: being the patron of debtors.
ऋणापनयन: ऋणापनयन n. (-नं) Discharge of a debt.  E. ऋण and अपनयन removing.
ऋणापनोदन: ऋणापनोदन n. (-नं) Payment of a debt.  E. ऋण and अपनोदन removing.
ऋणापाकरण: ऋणापाकरण n. (-णं) Paying off a debt.  E. ऋण and अपाकरण acquittance.
ऋणिक: ऋणिक m. (-कः) A debtor.  E. ऋण debt. वुन् aff.
ऋणिन्: ऋणिन् mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि) 	 1. Indebted. 	 2. Of or belonging to a debt. 	 m. (-णी) A debtor.  E. ऋण and इनि aff.
ऋणोद्ग्रहण: ऋणोद्ग्रहण n. (-णं) Recovering a debt in any way from the creditor, by friendly or legal proceedings, by stratagem, or by arrest.  E. ऋण and उद्ग्रहण taking.
ऋत: ऋत r. 6th cl. (ऋतति) 	 1. To go. 	 2. To have power. 	 3. To domineer. 	 4. To hate.
ऋत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Gone. 	 2. Enlightened, luminous. 	 3. Worshipped, respected. 	 4. True. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Gleaning. 	 2. Water. 	 3. Truth.  E. ऋ to go, affix क्त.
ऋतधामन्: ऋतधामन् m. (-मा) A name of VISHNU.  E. ऋत luminous, धामन् abode; whose residence is brilliant.
ऋतव्य: ऋतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Seasonable, in season, relating to a season. E. ऋतु and यत् aff.
ऋति: ऋति f. (-तिः) 	 1. Prosperity, felicity. 	 2. A road, a way. 	 3. Abuse, cen-sure, reproach. 	 4. Envy, emulation. 	 5. Going, motion. 	 6. Ill for-tune.  E. ऋ and क्तिन् aff.
ऋतिङ्कर: ऋतिङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Propitions, fortunate.  E. ऋति and कर what makes.
ऋतीया: ऋतीया f. (-या) 	 1. Censure, reproach, (according to some.) 	 2. Shame. E. ऋत Sautra root, to abuse, ईयच् affix, fem. टाप्.
ऋतु: ऋतु m. (-तुः) 	 1. A season, (the Hindu year is divided into six seasons, each consisting of two months.) 	 2. The menstrual evacuation. 3. The time favourable for procreation, or sixteen days in each month. 	 4. A month. 	 5. A kind of collyrium. 	 6. Light.  E. ऋ to go, तु Unādi aff.
ऋतुकाल: ऋतुकाल m. (-लः) 	 1. The duration of a season. 	 2. The period of menstru-ation. 	 3. The period favourable for procreation, sixteen days in each month.  E. ऋतु and काल time.
ऋतुगण: ऋतुगण m. (-णः) The seasons collectively.  E. ऋतु and गण a class.
ऋतुपर्याय: ऋतुपर्य्याय m. (-यः) The revolution of the season.  E. ऋतु and पर्य्याय revolution.
ऋतुपर्य्याय: ऋतुपर्य्याय m. (-यः) The revolution of the season.  E. ऋतु and पर्य्याय revolution.
ऋतुप्राप्त: ऋतुप्राप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Fruitful, fertile, &c. productive in due season. E. ऋतु season, and प्राप्त attained.
ऋतुमती: ऋतुमती f. (-ती) A woman during menstruation.  E. ऋतु, मतुष् aff.
ऋतुवृत्ति: ऋतुवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A year.  E. ऋतु a season, वृत्ति being.
ऋतुराज: ऋतुराज m. (-जः) Spring.  E. ऋतु and राजा king.
ऋतुलिङ्ग: ऋतुलिङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 	 1. A sign of the season. 	 2. A symptom of menstrua-tion.  E. ऋतु and लिङ्ग a mark.
ऋतुसन्धि: ऋतुसन्धि f. (-न्धिः) The interval or junction between two seasons: the last seven days of one season and the first seven of the next.  E. ऋतु and सन्धि union.
ऋतुसात्म्य: ऋतुसात्म्य n. (-त्म्यं) Diet, &c. suited to the season.  E. ऋतु and सात्म्य suitableness.
ऋतुस्नाता: ऋतुस्नाता f. (-ता) A woman who has bathed after menstruation.  E. ऋतु and स्राता bathed.
ऋते: ऋते ind. Besides, except.  E. ऋत Sautra root, to except, के aff.
ऋतोक्ति: ऋतोक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Speaking truth.  E. ऋत and उक्ति saying.
ऋत्वन्त: ऋत्वन्त m. (-न्तः) The close of a season. 	 2. The termination of menstru-ation.  E. ऋतु and अन्त term.
ऋत्विज्: ऋत्विज् m. (-त्विक्) 	 1. A domestic chaplain, a family priest.  E. ऋतु a season, यज् to worship, affix क्विन्, deriv. irr.
ऋद्ध: ऋद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Prosperous, thriving, rising, &c. 	 n. (-द्धं) 	 1. Stored grain. 	 2. A demonstrated conclusion, a distinct result.  E. ऋघ् to grow, &c. affix क्त.
ऋद्धि: ऋद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 	 1. A medicinal plant; also सिद्धि. 	 2. Increase, growth. 3. Fortune, prosperity. 	 4. A name of the goddess PARVATI.  E. ऋध to grow, &c., क्तिन् aff.
ऋद्धिमत्: ऋद्धिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Rich, prosperous.  E. ऋद्धि and मतुप् aff.
ऋध: ऋध r. 4th cl. (उ) ऋधु (ऋध्यति) To increase, to grow, to flourish, to prosper. r. 5th cl. (ऋध्नोति) 	 1. To increase, &c. 	 2. To augment or make increase. 	 3. To please.
ऋफ: ऋफ r. 6th cl. (ऋफति) To injure, to kill; also रिफ.
ऋभु: ऋभु m. (-भुः) 	 1. A deity. 	 2. A divinity of a particular order.  E. ऋ the mother of the gods, भू to be, डु affix; also रिभु.
ऋभुक्ष: ऋभुक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A name of INDRA. 	 2. INDRA'S heaven or paradise. 	 3. The thunderbolt of INDRA.  E. ऋभु a deity, क्षि to waste, to go, ड aff.
ऋभुक्षिन्: ऋभुक्षिन् m. (-क्षा) INDRA.  E. ऋभुक्ष paradise, &c. इनि aff.
ऋम्फ: ऋम्फ r. 6th cl. (ऋम्फति) To injure, to kill; also रिम्फ.
ऋश्य: ऋश्य m. (-श्यः) The painted or white-footed antelope.  E. ऋष् to go, क्यप् affix; also ऋष्य and रिश्य.
ऋष: ऋष r. 1st cl. (अर्षति) To take, to receive, to choose. (ई) ऋषी r. 6th cl. (ऋषति) To go, to approach.
ऋषभ: ऋषभ m. (-भः) 	 1. (In composition,) best, excellent. 	 2. A bull. 	 3. A dried plant, one of the eight principal medicaments. 	 4. The second of the seven notes of the Hindu gamut, in abbreviation, Ri. 	 5. The first of the twenty-four principal Jinas or Jaina saints. 6. The hollow of the air. 	 7. The name of a mountain. 	 8. A croco-dile's tail. 	 9. A boar's tail. 	 f. (-भी) 	 1. A masculine woman, a woman with a beard, &c. 	 2. A widow. 	 3. Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. ऋष् to go, अभच् Unādi aff.
ऋषभर्व्वज: ऋषभर्व्वज m. (-जः) A name of SIVA. 	 2. A Jaina saint.  E. ऋषभ and ध्वज a sign: he whose symbol is a bull.
ऋषि: ऋषि m. (-षिः) A Rishi or sanctified personage so called: there are seven orders of these saints, as the Srutarshi, Kandarshi, Paramarshi, Maharshi, Rajarshi, Brahmarshi and Devarshi: the uncompounded name is especially applied to seven sages, of the Brahmarshi order, cotemporary with each MANU; those of the present Manwantara, are MARICHI, ATRI, ANGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU and VASISHTHA: the names of each series differ: specified also form, in astronomy, the asterism of the greater bear: the Rishi of a Mantra or mystic prayer in the Vedis, is the saint by whom it is supposed to have been remembered or recited. 	 2. A Veda. 	 3. A ray of light. 	 4. A saint or sanctified sage in general. 	 f. (-षी) The wife of a Rishi. E. ऋष् to go, इन् Unādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्; who goes beyond the limits of earthly life and wisdom.
ऋषिकुल्या: ऋषिकुल्या f. (-ल्या) A river  E. ऋषि a saint, कुल्या an artificial canal: a ca-nal made by the saints.
ऋषिगण: ऋषिगण m. (-णः) A company or number of sages.  E. ऋषि and गण a number.
ऋषिजाङ्गलिकी: ऋषिजाङ्गलिकी f. (-की) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus:) see वृद्धताडक. E. ऋषि and जाङ्गलिक a dealer in antidotes, affix ङीप्.
ऋषिप्रोक्ता: ऋषिप्रोक्ता f. (-क्ता) A plant: see माषपर्णी.  E. ऋषि, प्रोक्त mentioned.
ऋषियज्ञ: ऋषियज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) The study of Scripture.  E. ऋषि a sage, and यज्ञ sacrifice.
ऋषीवह: ऋषीवह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or conveying a Rishi.  E. ऋषि and वह what bears, the final made long.
ऋष्टि: ऋष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A sword.  E. ऋष् to go, affix क्तिन्.
ऋष्य: ऋष्य m. (-ष्यः) The painted or white-footed antelope. 	 n. (-ष्यं) A sort of leprosy.  E. ऋष् to go, क्यप् affix: also ऋश्य, रिश्य.
ऋष्यकेतु: ऋष्यकेतु m. (-तुः) A name of ANIRUDDHA the son of KANDARPA.  E. ऋष्य and केतु a sign; having a deer for his symbol: some read this रिश्वकेतु, and others ऋश्यकेतु, ऋष्यकेतन, रिष्यकेतु, &c.
ऋष्यगता: ऋष्यगता f. (-ता) A plant, (Asparagus recemosus.)  E. ऋषि and अ before गत gone.
ऋष्यगन्धा: ऋष्यगन्धा f. (-न्धा) A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus:) see वृद्धताडक. E. ऋषि, अ priv. and गन्ध smell.
ऋष्यजिह्व: ऋष्यजिह्व n. (-ह्वं) A sort of leprosy.  E. ऋष्य the deer and जिह्वा the tongue; to which the blotches are compared.
ऋष्यप्रोक्ता: ऋष्यप्रोक्ता f. (-क्ता) 	 1. Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 	 2. Asparagus racemosus. 	 3. Sida, (cordifolia and rhombifolia.) E. See ऋषिप्रोक्ता.
ऋष्यमूक: ऋष्यमूक m. (-कः) A mountain in the Dakshin, the temporary abode of RAMA with the monkey-chief SUGRIVA.  E. ऋष्य a deer, मूक dumb.
ऋष्यशृङ्ग: ऋष्यशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The name of a holy sage celebrated in the first book of the Ramayana.
